title: Multi Tab Interface
definition: A user interface design with multiple tabs or pages that can be switched between, allowing for separate yet integrated functionality.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it like having multiple windows on your computer, but all within the same application. You can switch between them easily without closing the whole thing.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A multi-tab interface design allows for context switching between different functionalities while maintaining a unified user experience. It can enhance productivity and usability by providing seamless navigation between related tasks.
difficulty_levels.expert: The multi-tab interface design is a fundamental aspect of modern user experience design. It allows for parallel processing, improving efficiency and reducing cognitive load. Furthermore, it enables a more modular and scalable application architecture. This design has been adopted in various fields, including web browsers, text editors, and integrated development environments.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation revealed the need for a multi-tab interface design that allows for the integration of a conversational LLM interface with the existing mycelium browser.
